name: shared-events

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them. The tests also read files elsewhere: the legacy-map test searches apps/auth-server/src and libs/infra/db/src/scripts for today's event names, and the artifact tests compare the generated schemas, the docs page and the stable-surface registry with the committed copies. Without these entries a change to one of those files would replay a cached pass.

schema-export.description: Write the event contract's generated files from the registry: one JSON Schema per event type and the envelope's schema under apps/docs-site/public/schemas/events/, and the docs page apps/docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/events.md. The stable-surface check runs it and fails on drift.
